from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class TradableFinancialAssets(BaseModel):
    """One reported trading financial asset value from a company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company the report belongs to")
    asset_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written in the report")
    asset_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the asset")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period this value covers")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., 'CNY' or '元'")
    is_year_start: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this value is year-start/initial balance")
    is_period_end: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this value is period-end/ending balance")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    tradable_financial_assets: list[TradableFinancialAssets]
